analysis.reading: A DOUBLE COLLISION IN A COMMERCIAL CATALOGUE. Card 1 is centralbookingnyc.com, a New York art gallery, whose page carries BOTH "The Crimson Hexagon, 2022. $2,800.00" and "Sappho’s Raft, 2009. $950.00". Every other collision read so far matched one term; this matches both halves of a two-term query, in one catalogue, with prices. Card 7 also surfaces a disclaimer from the archive’s own text as a source snippet: "Crimson Hexagon is not a religion and does not claim to be one." A denial written into a deposit is retrieved and displayed as a description of the thing it denies.
